pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which melody uses only steps? (1 mark)
   A. d m d m
   B. d r m r d
   C. d d m d
   D. m d m d

2. A sprint is (1 mark)
   A. a throwing event
   B. a jump into sand
   C. a short race run at full speed
   D. a very long race

3. Which of these is a dark tone of red? (1 mark)
   A. Red mixed with white
   B. Red mixed with a little black
   C. Red mixed with water
   D. Red mixed with yellow

4. Which is a rule for water games? (1 mark)
   A. Play alone
   B. Dunk friends
   C. Ignore the whistle
   D. Do not hold anyone under water

5. When you give feedback on a friend's photograph you should (1 mark)
   A. say nothing
   B. laugh
   C. say what you like first and then suggest one improvement
   D. say it is terrible

6. Gestures in singing are (1 mark)
   A. hand and body movements that fit the song
   B. quiet time
   C. sounds of the drum
   D. words only

7. Smudging a charcoal drawing means (1 mark)
   A. erasing it completely
   B. painting over it
   C. rubbing it gently so the tones blend
   D. folding the paper

8. Which of these is a national day on which the anthem is sung? (1 mark)
   A. Sports day only
   B. Jamhuri Day
   C. Birthday of a friend
   D. Market day

9. The element of light means (1 mark)
   A. the weight of the camera
   B. the price
   C. how well the subject is lit
   D. the size of the photo

10. How should you use steps or a ladder to enter? (1 mark)
   A. Go head first
   B. Face the steps, hold the rails and go feet first
   C. Jump onto them
   D. Ignore rails

11. On a xylophone, the long bars give (1 mark)
   A. low notes
   B. no sound
   C. high notes
   D. only clapping sounds

12. Which folk songs are sung while working? (1 mark)
   A. Naming songs
   B. Funeral songs
   C. Marriage songs
   D. Work songs

13. What should you do if something hurts during gymnastics? (1 mark)
   A. Keep going
   B. Stop and tell your teacher
   C. Hide it
   D. Push a friend

14. To make a very dark tone with charcoal you should (1 mark)
   A. use no charcoal
   B. use water
   C. press harder
   D. press very lightly

15. Which game uses small sinking toys? (1 mark)
   A. Treasure hunt
   B. Circle walk
   C. Follow the leader
   D. Water tag

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe the steps of taking a photograph with a digital device. (5 marks)

17. State the lengths of a crotchet rest and a quaver rest and how to show a rest when clapping. (3 marks)

18. Why is light important in photography? (2 marks)

19. State three points to check when giving feedback to a friend playing the recorder. (3 marks)

20. What is the difference between tempo and dynamics? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — d r m r d
   Each move in d r m r d is to a neighbouring note.

2. C — a short race run at full speed
   Sprints such as 50 m or 100 m are short races.

3. B — Red mixed with a little black
   Adding black makes a darker shade of red.

4. D — Do not hold anyone under water
   Safety first.

5. C — say what you like first and then suggest one improvement
   Kind and helpful feedback works best.

6. A — hand and body movements that fit the song
   Gestures help tell the story of a song.

7. C — rubbing it gently so the tones blend
   Smudging spreads the charcoal so that light and dark blend smoothly.

8. B — Jamhuri Day
   Jamhuri Day is a national holiday.

9. C — how well the subject is lit
   Light is a key element.

10. B — Face the steps, hold the rails and go feet first
   Use the rails and enter carefully.

11. A — low notes
   Longer bars vibrate more slowly and sound lower.

12. D — Work songs
   Work songs give rhythm to work.

13. B — Stop and tell your teacher
   Pain is a warning, so stop and tell the teacher.

14. C — press harder
   Pressing harder leaves more charcoal, so the tone is darker.

15. A — Treasure hunt
   Players pick up toys from the pool bottom.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Check the battery and memory and wipe the lens. Decide the subject. Check the light and centre of interest. Hold with two hands and keep elbows close. Frame the subject and press the button gently. Check the result and retake if needed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid stage.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: A crotchet rest is one beat of silence and a quaver rest is half a beat of silence. When clapping, we do not clap but keep the beat silently.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each length, 1 mark for showing the rest.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Light lets the camera record the picture. With good light the subject is clear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Correct notes, steady rhythm and rests, clear tone without squeaks, good posture. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tempo is the speed of the music. Dynamics are how loud or soft the music is.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
